about.label: About
about.heading: A laid-back, results-driven engineer.
paragraphs: I have a Master’s in Computer Science from SUNY Buffalo. I design scalable microservices, optimize high-performance REST APIs, and build intelligent systems with agentic frameworks. I like owning complex problems and mentoring teammates, and I bring React skills when the front end needs it.
Outside tech: stock markets, current politics, social issues, and photography.

items.summary: Architected a schema-driven WebSocket-to-gRPC/NATS gateway in Python + FastAPI that generates routing rules from Protobuf definitions, and built the multi-stage CI/CD pipeline for data-quality checks.
Architected a multi-persona agentic AI framework with 5+ configurable LLM agents, cutting prompt variance by 25%. Built transcription, Stripe billing and a Manifest V3 meeting-capture extension.

Grew from intern to SDE. Built the personalised engagement backend behind the Bajaj Health app and web homepage, serving over 2 million people, and led Wellness OPT IN, Circle of Care and TVS Chronic Care.
Designed and shipped a MERN website for the client The Investico in 10 days, deployed on AWS.
Built the cart-management backend for mobile covers and merchandise with Node.js and MongoDB.

items.title: RapidMock
items.description: An API mocking and management platform: mock, validate and forward requests, with JWT auth, versioning, request logging and per-project analytics.

items.title: Shop-Sphere
items.description: A microservice e-commerce backend on Node.js with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka and Redis, plus LLM tooling that automates unit tests and API docs.

items.title: UrbanTree+
items.description: PySpark ETL pipelines that cluster 130K+ urban tree records into geospatial planting recommendations using K-Means, regression and MapReduce.

items.title: ChatFlow
items.description: A distributed C++ TCP chat system with offline message buffering, user blocking, broadcast messaging and real-time routing using select().

items.title: Anomaly Detection with PCA & Autoencoders
items.description: Predicts machine anomalies from engine and sensor data using Principal Component Analysis and autoencoders. Published as a chapter in a Springer book.

items.title: Framework for Disease Detection
items.description: A platform that helps people find doctors and symptom information, and predicts diseases with 95% accuracy.

items.title: Phishing Website Detection
items.description: Compared 9 machine learning algorithms for detecting phishing websites. Published on SSRN.

items.title: Idea Invest Implement
items.description: A web portal where sponsors explore startup ideas and back ventures, built to scale past 10,000 products.

items.title: Digital Election System
items.description: An online voting platform with face-recognition identity checks, which raised participation by over 30%.

items.title: Lip Biometry on Handheld OS
items.description: Research comparing lip-biometric algorithms and their compatibility with mobile operating systems. Published in IRJET.
